5270-the-film-mystery.title: The Film Mystery
5270-the-film-mystery.creator: Unknown
5270-the-film-mystery.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. Before us lay the body of the girl, remarkably beautiful even as she lay motionless in death. Her masses of golden hair, disheveled, added to the soft contours of her features. Her wonderfully large blue-gray eyes with their rare gift for delicate shades of expression were closed, but long curling lashes swept her cheeks still and it was hard to believe that this was anything more than sleep.

arxiv-1505-00387.title: Highway Networks
arxiv-1505-00387.creator: Rupesh Kumar Srivastava, Klaus Greff, Jürgen Schmidhuber
arxiv-1505-00387.description: Abstract There is plenty of theoretical and empirical evidence that depth of neural networks is a crucial ingredient for their success. However, network training becomes more difficult with increasing depth and training of very deep networks remains an open problem. In this extended abstract, we introduce a new architecture designed to ease gradient-based training of very deep networks.

arxiv-2309-11759.title: Symbol Detection for Coarsely Quantized OTFS
arxiv-2309-11759.creator: Junwei He, Haochuan Zhang*, Chao Dong, Huimin Zhu
arxiv-2309-11759.description: Abstract This paper explicitly models a coarse and noisy quantization in a communication system empowered by orthogonal time frequency space (OTFS) for cost and power efficiency. We first point out, with coarse quantization, the effective channel is imbalanced and thus no longer able to circularly shift the transmitted symbols along the delay-Doppler domain.

arxiv-2311-03364.title: BDD-Based Framework with RL Integration: An approach for videogames automated testing
arxiv-2311-03364.creator: Vincent Mastain, Fabio Petrillo
arxiv-2311-03364.description: Abstract Testing plays a vital role in software development, but in the realm of video games, the process differs from traditional software development practices. Game developers typically rely on human testers who are provided with checklists to evaluate various elements.

arxiv-2508-03342.title: From Legacy to Standard: LLM-Assisted Transformation of Cybersecurity Playbooks into CACAO Format
arxiv-2508-03342.creator: Mehdi Akbari Gurabi, Lasse Nitz, Radu-Mihai Castravet, Roman Matzutt, Avikarsha Mandal, Stefan Decker
arxiv-2508-03342.description: Abstract Existing cybersecurity playbooks are often written in heterogeneous, non-machine-readable formats, which limits their automation and interoperability across Security Orchestration, Automation, and Response platforms. This paper explores the suitability of Large Language Models, combined with Prompt Engineering, to automatically translate legacy incident response playbooks into the standardized, machine-readable CACAO format.

arxiv-2509-14840.title: Coupling 4H-Silicon Carbide spins to a microwave resonator at milli-Kelvin temperature
arxiv-2509-14840.creator: Ali Fawaz, Jeremy Bourhill, Stefania Castelletto, Hiroshi Abe, Takeshi Ohshima, Michael Tobar, Thomas Volz, Maxim Goryachev, Sarath Raman Nair
arxiv-2509-14840.description: Abstract Coupling microwave cavity modes with spin qubit transitions is crucial for enabling efficient qubit readout and control, long-distance qubit coupling, quantum memory implementation, and entanglement generation. We experimentally observe the coupling of different spin qubit transitions in Silicon Carbide (SiC) material to a 3D microwave (MW) resonator mode around 12.6 GHz at a temperature of 10 mK.

arxiv-2512-04737.title: Recent advances in the numerical solution of multi-order fractional differential equations
arxiv-2512-04737.creator: Luigi Brugnano, Gianmarco Gurioli, Felice Iavernaro, Mikk Vikerpuur
arxiv-2512-04737.description: Abstract The efficient numerical solution of fractional differential equations has been recently tackled through the definition of Fractional HBVMs (FHBVMs), a class of Runge-Kutta type methods. Corresponding Matlab © {}^{\copyright}\, codes have been also made available on the internet, proving to be very competitive w.r.t. existing ones.

arxiv-2603-17512.creator: Mengyu Bu, Yang Feng

pmc-10517507.title: PEDF inhibits LPS-induced acute lung injury in rats and promotes lung epithelial cell survival by upregulating PPAR-γ
pmc-10517507.creator: Lei Xu, Yifei Chen, Shoujie Feng, Zeyan Liu, Ying Ye, Ranran Zhou, Lijun Liu
pmc-10517507.description: BackgroundThe progression of acute lung injury (ALI) involves numerous pathological factors and complex mechanisms, and cause the destruction of epithelial and endothelial barriers. Pigment epithelium-derived factor (PEDF) is an angiogenesis inhibitor and a potential anti-inflammatory factor. The purpose of this study was to investigate the effect of PEDF on lipopolysaccharide (LPS)-induced ALI in rats.

pmc-11305037.title: Foliar application of salicylic acid improved morpho-anatomical features of potato by irrigating with wastewater
pmc-11305037.creator: Sheza Ayaz Khilji, Aqsa Rafique, Zahoor Ahmad Sajid, Mamoona Rauf, Anis Ali Shah, Shifa Shaffique, Mansour K Gatasheh
pmc-11305037.description: BackgroundThis study aimed to evaluate the suitability of using drain water as a source of irrigation and its effects along with salicylic acid on morphological, anatomical, physico-chemical as well as yield attributes of potato. For this study, potato tubers were grown in pots and irrigated with different concentrations of drain water. Salicylic acid treatments vis. 0, 0.5 and 1.

pmc-12953905.title: Use of MALDI-TOF mass spectrometry for identification of Weissella tructae
pmc-12953905.creator: Francisco Yan Tavares Reis, Júlio César Câmara Rosa, César Ortega, Ruben Avendaño-Herrera, Henrique César Pereira Figueiredo
pmc-12953905.description: Weissella ceti, the etiological agent of hemorrhagic septicemia in rainbow trout (Oncorhynchus mykiss), was recently reclassified as a new species, Weissella tructae. This taxonomic update underscores the need for diagnostic methods capable of accurately identifying W. tructae and distinguishing it from W. ceti in a rapid, reliable, and cost-effective manner.

pmc-13156587.title: Dyke-Davidoff-Masson syndrome in a young adult: Lifelong hemiparesis and characteristic MRI findings
pmc-13156587.creator: Yohannes Girma Zewdie, Chalew Abebe Mengesha, Hana Yeshewas Genetirune
pmc-13156587.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Dyke-Davidoff-Masson syndrome (DDMS) is a rare disorder characterized by cerebral hemiatrophy and compensatory calvarial changes. We report a 22-year-old male with lifelong left-sided spastic hemiparesis and developmental delay, with a history of prematurity, neonatal meningitis, and childhood head trauma. Brain MRI demonstrated right cerebral hemiatrophy, exvacuo dilatation of the lateral ventricle, ipsilateral sulcal prominence, calvarial thickening, frontal sinus enlargement, and Wallerian degeneration of the corticospinal tract.

pmc-13206521.title: Predominance of Ferroptotic Cell Death Mechanisms in Substantia Nigra Neurodegeneration in Parkinson's Disease
pmc-13206521.creator: Yue Jing Heng, Anusha Jayaraman, Richard Reynolds, Jia Nee Foo
pmc-13206521.description: ObjectiveThe extent of neuronal loss in Parkinson's disease (PD) and the pathogenic processes underlying neuronal dysfunction and loss remain poorly understood. Here, we analyzed the expression of key molecules representing different cell death signaling pathways and their association with Lewy pathology, dopaminergic (DA) neuron loss and stage of PD progression in human postmortem brain tissue.

pmc-13457785.title: Validation of Self-Reported Disease History in Korea: A National Health Insurance Cohort Study
pmc-13457785.creator: Yeon Woo Oh, Eun-Cheol Park
pmc-13457785.description: BackgroundSelf-reported disease history is widely used in epidemiological studies but is susceptible to misclassification. This study aimed to evaluate the accuracy of self-reported history of hypertension, diabetes, dyslipidemia, and stroke in Korea and to identify factors associated with reporting accuracy.

pmc-13632052.title: Preoperative systemic immune inflammation index predicts early complications and 30-day mortality after heart valve surgery: a retrospective cohort study
pmc-13632052.creator: IMade Adi Parmana, Dudy Arman Hanafy, Cindy Elfira Boom
pmc-13632052.description: BackgroundThe systemic immune-inflammation index (SII) is considered a promising inflammatory index for predicting adverse outcomes in cardiovascular diseases. However, its prognostic value in patients undergoing heart valve surgery remains unclear. This study aimed to investigate the predictive significance of preoperative SII for early postoperative complications and 30-day mortality.

pmc-13672140.title: Human inflammatory bowel disease-on-a-chip for modelling disease progression, cancer initiation and sex-specific effects
pmc-13672140.creator: Alican Özkan, Gwenn E Merry, David B Chou, Ryan R Posey, Anna Stejskalova, Karina Calderon, Megan Sperry, Joshua Piatok, Viktor Horvath, Lorenzo E Ferri, Emanuela Carlotti, Stuart A C McDonald, Douglas J Winton, Rocco Ricciardi, Liliana Bordeianou, Sean Hall, Girija Goyal, Donald E Ingber
pmc-13672140.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). Patients affected by inflammatory bowel disease (IBD) exhibit compromised intestinal barrier function and decreased mucus accumulation, as well as increased inflammation, fibrosis and cancer risk, with symptoms often being exacerbated in women during pregnancy. Here we replicate these IBD hallmarks in human-derived organ-on-a-chip devices lined by colon epithelial cells from individuals with IBD when interfaced with matched fibroblasts, cultured under flow, exposed to peristalsis-like motions and perfused with circulating immune cells.
